text: Infrastructure is split between Terraform and Bicep. Before provisioning it, we plan the real-time path a scan event takes from a driver's handheld scanner into Kafka.
One topic, fernbridge.delivery-events, with 24 partitions, feeds two independent consumer groups -- Databricks landing Bronze, and Fabric feeding the live Eventhouse support reps use.
The topic is keyed on vehicle ID, not event ID, so every event from one vehicle stays in order as it moves through the pipeline, even with 200 vehicles streaming at once.
We're writing down real targets -- under a minute into Bronze, under ten seconds into the Eventhouse -- instead of a vague promise of real-time.
The ingestion path is planned. Next: opening Terraform and the Azure CLI for real to provision it.
